best_idea: A target frame that shows a 10-cell health bar for the current target, goes to an all-dash box when the target is out of sight (no stale number), and keeps health colour separate from status words.
decision_why: Read-only HUD on engine state that fits row 14; keep the 10-cell bar, unknown box and status-as-tags; change star buckets to ceil(pct/10) and guard maxhp; the frame takes up to three attackers from the engine hate list, not one tracked monster.
acceptance: In a duel the target frame shows 10 cells for a full-health enemy and drops a cell per 10 percent of max hp; an enemy out of sight shows [----------] in the unknown colour; a sleeping enemy keeps its health colour and gains an asleep tag. Test: targetBar({visible:false,...}).box equals [----------] and starCount(10,10) equals 1.
